# casdoor_permission (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor permission, a Casbin policy that grants users, groups or roles actions on resources.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_permission" "portal_admin" {
  owner         = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name          = "portal-admin"
  display_name  = "Portal admin"
  roles         = ["acme/admins"]
  resource_type = "Application"
  resources     = [casdoor_application.portal.name]
  actions       = ["Read", "Write"]
  effect        = "Allow"
  is_enabled    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the permission, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `actions` (List of String) The actions, e.g. `Read`, `Write` or `Admin`.
- `adapter` (String) The name of the adapter that stores the policies.
- `description` (String) The description.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `domains` (List of String) The domains.
- `effect` (String) The effect, `Allow` or `Deny`.
- `groups` (List of String) The groups, in the `organization/group` format.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the permission is enabled.
- `model` (String) The name of the Casbin model.
- `resource_type` (String) The resource type, e.g. `Application`, `TreeNode` or `Custom`.
- `resources` (List of String) The resources.
- `roles` (List of String) The roles, in the `organization/role` format.
- `state` (String) The approval state, `Approved` or `Pending`. Only approved permissions take effect.
- `users` (List of String) The users, in the `organization/user` format.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the permission was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the permission in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_permission.example <organization>/<name>
```
